main-disclaimer: Please note that the images generated are based on AI technology which has certain limitations. The results may vary in accuracy, detail, and realism depending on the input image and selected scenario. The generated modifications are approximate visual representations and should not be seen as exact predictions or real outcomes.
solar-disclaimer: AI will add solar energy elements at appropriate locations. Best suited for images showing buildings or open spaces.
wind-disclaimer: AI will add wind turbines to suitable landscape areas. Ideal for landscape or rural scenes without dense urban features.
no-climate-protection-disclaimer: AI will show environmental damage and reduced greenery due to pollution. Suitable for images with visible vegetation and built environment.
greening-and-de-sealing-disclaimer: AI will add moderate greenery and reduce paved surfaces. Works well with urban or suburban scenes showing streets and green areas.
sealing-disclaimer: AI will increase paved and concrete areas while reducing green spaces. Suitable for images with visible vegetation and open areas.
alternative-transportation-disclaimer: AI will replace vehicles with alternative transport modes and pedestrian activity. Best for urban street scenes with visible traffic.
flood-disclaimer: AI will simulate flooding and rain effects while keeping key features visible. Works best with outdoor scenes showing streets or landscapes.
drought-disclaimer: AI will alter the scene to reflect dry conditions and stressed vegetation. Works well with outdoor scenes including greenery and open spaces.
